author: /root
role: prospective analysis of previously exposed development data; no new holdout
target: derive receiver reference and a testable carrier estimator class before scalar inference

samples.products: both previously exposed day1691335 X/Ka RSR products
samples.blocks: 600 individual one-second blocks per band; no sample/record clipping; all flags retained
samples.complex_voltage: (2I+1)+i(2Q+1); both physical sideband signs retained until source or registered tracking comparison resolves them

estimator.model: a single complex sinusoid with unrestricted complex amplitude in each one-second block; explicit candidate approximation, not derived physical truth
estimator.objective: unweighted least squared Euclidean error in corrected ADC units; eliminate amplitude analytically
estimator.refinement: bounded scalar minimization within one FFT grid spacing of strongest grid peak; record both grid and refinement; no claim of globally exact maximizer from refinement
estimator.deterministic_global_bound: centered-time correlation derivative <= 2*pi*sum(abs(t_n)*abs(z_n)); cover radius1000/(2*16000). This bounds global maximum correlation from its grid maximum. Clamp upper bound at Cauchy bound. Residual lower bound then max(0,||z||^2 - upper^2/N).
estimator.quantization_test: conditional ideal unsaturated square cells with half-width1 after2k+1. Pure constant-complex-amplitude single-tone compatible only if minimum distance <= sqrt(2N). Global residual lower bound above2N rejects that particular candidate. No analog-noise upper bound is inferred.

tracking_comparison.selection: all coherent ODF rx25 tx54 Xdownlink intervals fully contained in the fixed600sec RSR window, matching calendar and count endpoints; preserve flags and alternatives
tracking_comparison.reference: derive from primary pre-NSP/BlockV tracking definition; never substitute transmit ramp at reception without source support
tracking_comparison.candidates: physical I+iQ sideband orientations + and -, documented NCO phase-argument alternatives0 and0.5ms; compare all without fitting an offset/time shift/scale
tracking_comparison.statistics: signed error min/median/max/RMS and raw row ledger, counts and missing coverage; no likelihood, outlier removal or scalar fit
tracking_comparison.scope: cross-receiver development consistency; not independent gravity evidence. If reference remains ambiguous, retain alternatives and explicitly report inability to identify.

prohibitions: no sign/timing/offset selected by scalar residual
no inferred stochastic distribution from a small residual
no total-voltage angle identified as physical carrier phase
planned_checks: synthetic known sinusoids at positive/negative/near-Nyquist frequencies
rigorous grid covering bound vs known synthetic frequencies
quantization-only tone feasible and rejected countermodels
epoch/LO/NCO signs and integrated polynomial vs discrete hold identities
